268: static int send_slot(struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
269:                      uint32_t *order)
270: {
271:   uint32_t wire[2];
272:   int ret;
273: 
274:   *order = ++g_send_order;
275:   wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)message;
276:   wire[1] = sizeof(*message);
277:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
278:   ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, wire);
279:   if (ret == OK)
280:     {
281:       g_stats.tx++;
282:     }
283:   else if (ret == -EAGAIN)
284:     {
285:       g_stats.fifo_full++;
286:     }
287: 
288:   if (ret < 0)
289:     {
290:       g_stats.last_tx_error = (uint32_t)(-ret);
291:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(3,
292:         (g_stats.last_tx_error & 0xffu) |
293:         ((g_stats.timeout & 0xffu) << 8) |
294:         ((g_stats.fifo_full & 0xffu) << 16) |
295:         ((g_stats.ack_overflow & 0xffu) << 24));
296:     }
297: 
298:   return ret;
299: }

336: static void complete_transaction(struct active_transaction *active,
337:                                  const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
338:                                  int result)

392: static void select_recovery_epoch(void)
393: {
394:   unsigned int i;
395:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = NULL;
396: 
397:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
398:     {
399:       if (!g_recovery[i].probe.quarantine &&
400:           !g_recovery[i].reset_sent && !g_recovery[i].probe.busy)
401:         {
402:           epoch = &g_recovery[i];
403:           g_recovery_index = i;
404:           break;
405:         }
406:     }
407: 
408:   if (epoch == NULL)
409:     {
410:       uint32_t newest = 0;
411: 
412:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
413:         {
414:           if (g_recovery[i].probe.order >= newest)
415:             {
416:               newest = g_recovery[i].probe.order;
417:               epoch = &g_recovery[i];
418:               g_recovery_index = i;
419:             }
420:         }
421: 
422:       epoch->replay = true;
423:       g_stats.recovery_replay++;
424:     }
425:   else
426:     {
427:       memset(epoch, 0, sizeof(*epoch));
428:       epoch->reset.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
429:         0, 0, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET, 0,
430:         BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX);
431:     }
432: 
433:   g_probe_attempts = 0;
434:   g_reset_pending = !epoch->replay;
435:   g_stats.recovery_cycle++;
436:   set_link_state(epoch->replay ? BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING :
437:                                  BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING);
438: }

440: static void begin_abort(int result)
441: {
442:   struct active_transaction *probe = busy_probe();
443: 
444:   if (g_active.busy)
445:     {
446:       g_active.quarantine = true;
447:       complete_transaction(&g_active, NULL, result);
448:     }
449: 
450:   if (probe != NULL)
451:     {
452:       probe->quarantine = true;
453:       complete_transaction(probe, NULL, result);
454:     }
455: 
456:   fail_pending(result);
457:   g_probe_requested = false;
458:   select_recovery_epoch();
459: }

462: {

464: 
465:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
466:     {
467:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_FREE)
468:         {

478: static int dispatch_locked(void)
479: {
480:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
481:   struct active_transaction *active;
482:   struct logical_channel *channel;
483:   unsigned int i;
484:   int ret;
485: 
486:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
487: 
488:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
489:     {
490:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
491:         {
492:           continue;
493:         }
494: 
495:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
496:       if (ret < 0)
497:         {
498:           return ret;
499:         }
500: 
501:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
502:     }
503: 
504:   if (g_reset_pending)
505:     {
506:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
507:       if (ret < 0)
508:         {
509:           return ret;
510:         }
511: 
512:       g_reset_pending = false;
513:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
514:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
515:     }
516: 
517:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
518:     {
519:       return OK;
520:     }
521: 
522:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
523:     {
524:       channel = &g_channels[i];
525:       if (!channel->queued)
526:         {
527:           continue;
528:         }
529: 
530:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
531:         {
532:           if (g_channel_ids[i] == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
533:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) ==
534:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
535:             {
536:               active = &epoch->probe;
537:             }
538:           else if (is_liveness_channel(g_channel_ids[i]))
539:             {
540:               active = &g_active;
541:             }
542:           else
543:             {
544:               continue;
545:             }
546: 
547:           if (active == &epoch->probe && active->quarantine &&
548:               !epoch->replay)
549:             {
550:               return -ENOLINK;
551:             }
552:         }
553:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
554:         {
555:           active = &g_active;
556:           if (active->quarantine)
557:             {
558:               return -ENOLINK;
559:             }
560:         }
561:       else if (is_liveness_channel(g_channel_ids[i]) &&
562:                g_link_state != BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN)
563:         {
564:           active = &g_active;
565:         }
566:       else
567:         {
568:           return OK;
569:         }
570: 
571:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
572:         {
573:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
574:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
575:                  sizeof(active->message));
576:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
577:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
578:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
579:             g_channel_ids[i]);
580:         }
581: 
582:       active->callback = channel->callback;
583:       active->arg = channel->arg;
584:       active->channel_index = i;
585:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
586:       active->busy = true;
587:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
588:       if (ret < 0)
589:         {
590:           active->busy = false;
591:           return ret;
592:         }
593: 
594:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
595:         {
596:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
597:             {
598:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
599:             }
600: 
601:           g_probe_attempts++;
602:           g_stats.probes++;
603:         }
604: 
605:       return OK;
606:     }
607: 
608:   return OK;
609: }

611: static uint32_t ack_header_reason(
612:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
613:   const struct active_transaction *active)
614: {
615:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
616:   uint32_t reason = 0;
617: 
618:   if (!active->busy)
619:     {
620:       return 1u;
621:     }
622: 
623:   if (control != BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
624:     {
625:       reason |= 2u;
626:     }
627:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) !=
628:       bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message))
629:     {
630:       reason |= 4u;
631:     }
632:   if (bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) !=
633:       bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message))
634:     {
635:       reason |= 8u;
636:     }
637:   if (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) !=
638:       bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message))
639:     {
640:       reason |= 16u;
641:     }
642: 
643:   return reason;
644: }

646: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
647: {
648:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
649:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
650:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
651: }
652: 
653: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
654: {
655:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
656:   struct active_transaction *active;
657:   bool replay;
658:   int result;
659:   uint32_t reason;
660: 
661: 
662:   active = busy_probe();
663:   if (active == NULL)
664:     {
665:       active = &g_active;
666:     }
667: 
668:   g_stats.last_ack_header = message->header;
669:   g_stats.last_active_header = active->message.header;
670:   reason = ack_header_reason(message, active);
671:   if (reason != 0)
672:     {
673:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
674:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= reason;
675:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, g_stats.last_ack_header);
676:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, g_stats.last_active_header);
677:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
678:       return;
679:     }
680: 
681: 
682:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
683:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
684:     {
685:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
686: 
687:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
688:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 32u;
689:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
690:       return;
691:     }
692: 
693:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
694:     {
695:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
696:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 64u;
697:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
698:       return;
699:     }
700: 
701:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
702:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
703: 
704:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
705:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
706:     {
707:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
708:     }
709: 
710:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
711:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
712:   if (replay)
713:     {
714:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
715:       unsigned int i;
716: 
717:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
718:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
719:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
720:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
721:        */
722: 
723:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
724:       g_active.quarantine = false;
725:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
726:         {
727:           if (i != replay_index)
728:             {
729:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
730:             }
731:         }
732: 
733:       select_recovery_epoch();
734:       (void)dispatch_locked();
735:       return;
736:     }
737: 
738:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
739: 
740:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
741:     {
742:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
743:         {
744:           release_recovery_slots();
745:           g_recovery_index = 0;
746:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
747:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
748:         }
749:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
750:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
751:         {
752:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
753:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
754:            */
755:         }
756:       else
757:         {
758:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
759:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
760:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
761:         }
762:     }
763: 
764:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
765:            result < 0)
766:     {
767:       begin_abort(result);
768:     }
769: 
770:   (void)dispatch_locked();
771: }

773: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
774: {
775:   struct ack_slot *slot;
776:   unsigned int rx_index;
777:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
778:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
779:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
780:   uint8_t state = 0;
781:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
782: 
783:   g_stats.last_command_header = message->header;
784: 
785:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
786:     {
787:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
788:       if (slot == NULL)
789:         {
790:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
791:           return -EAGAIN;
792:         }
793:     }
794:   else
795:     {
796:       slot = NULL;
797:     }
798: 
799:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
800:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
801:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
802:     {
803:       g_stats.bad_header++;
804:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
805:     }
806:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
807:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
808:     {
809:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
810:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
811:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
812:         {
813:           if (slot != NULL)
814:             {
815:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
816:             }
817: 
818:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
819:           return -EAGAIN;
820:         }
821:       else if (ret < 0)
822:         {
823:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
824:         }
825:     }
826:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
827:     {
828:       ret = g_pwc_rx(message);
829:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
830:         {
831:           if (slot != NULL)
832:             {
833:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
834:             }
835: 
836:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
837:           return -EAGAIN;
838:         }
839:       else if (ret < 0)
840:         {
841:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
842:         }
843:     }
844:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_SARADC_RX &&
845:            (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 0u ||
846:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 1u) &&
847:            message->payload_address == 1u &&
848:            message->payload_length == 0u && message->flags == 0u &&
849:            message->crc8 == 0u && message->reserved == 0u)
850:     {
851:       /* Match Armino's SARADC operation-notification ABI. */
852:       ack_flags = 2u;
853:       ret = OK;
854:     }
855:   else
856:     {
857:       g_stats.unsupported++;
858:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
859:     }
860: 
861:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
862:     {
863:       return OK;
864:     }
865: 
866:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
867:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
868:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
869:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
870:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
871: 
872:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
873:     {
874:       g_probe_requested = true;
875:     }
876: 
877:   (void)dispatch_locked();
878:   return OK;
879: }

881: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
882: {
883:   irqstate_t flags;
884:   uint8_t control;
885: 
886:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
887:   g_stats.rx++;
888:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
889: 
890:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
891:     {
892:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
893:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
894:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
895:         {
896:           g_stats.bad_header++;
897:         }
898:       else
899:         {
900:           g_stats.resets++;
901:           g_peer_reset_generation++;
902:           bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred();
903:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
904:         }
905:     }
906:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
907:     {
908:       handle_ack(message);
909:     }
910:   else
911:     {
912:       int ret = handle_command(message);
913: 
914:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
915:         {
916:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
917:           return ret;
918:         }
919:     }
920: 
921:   if (up_cpu_index() == 0)
922:     {
923:       (void)dispatch_locked();
924:     }
925: 
926:   if (up_cpu_index() == 0)
927:     {
928:       (void)dispatch_locked();
929:     }
930: 
931:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
932:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
933:   return OK;
934: }

936: static int mailbox_diag_worker(int argc, char **argv)
937: {
938:   enum bk7258_mb_link_state reported = BK7258_MB_LINK_QUIESCING;
939:   int ret;
940: 
941:   (void)argc;
942:   (void)argv;
943:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
944:   if (ret < 0)
945:     {
946:       return -EXDEV;
947:     }
948: 
949:   for (;;)
950:     {
951:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_diag_sem);
952:       irqstate_t flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
953:       enum bk7258_mb_link_state state = g_diag_state;
954:       bk7258_mb_link_callback_t callback = g_link_callback;
955:       void *callback_arg = g_link_arg;
956:       uint32_t timeout = g_stats.timeout;
957:       uint32_t bad_ack = g_stats.bad_ack;
958:       uint8_t epoch = g_recovery_index;
959: 
960:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
961:       if (reported == state)
962:         {
963:           continue;

966:       reported = state;
967:       if (reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
968:           reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
969:         {
970:           syslog(LOG_WARNING,
971:                  "mailbox: link state=%u epoch=%u timeout=%lu bad_ack=%lu\n",
972:                  reported, epoch, (unsigned long)timeout,
973:                  (unsigned long)bad_ack);
974:         }
975: 
976:       if (callback != NULL)
977:         {
978:           callback(reported, callback_arg);
979:         }
980:     }
981: 
982:   return OK;
983: }

985: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
986: {
987:   int ret;
988: 
989:   (void)argc;
990:   (void)argv;
991:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
992:   if (ret < 0)
993:     {
994:       ret = -EXDEV;
995:     }
996: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
997:   else if (bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() <
998:            BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_WAIT)
999:     {
1000:       ret = -EAGAIN;
1001:     }
1002: #endif
1003:   if (ret < 0)
1004:     {
1005:       return ret;
1006:     }
1007: 
1008:   for (;;)
1009:     {
1010:       struct active_transaction *probe;
1011:       irqstate_t flags;
1012:       bool request_probe;
1013: 
1014:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
1015:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1016: 
1017:       probe = busy_probe();
1018:       if ((g_active.busy &&
1019:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
1020:           (probe != NULL &&
1021:            clock_systime_ticks() - probe->started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
1022:         {
1023:           g_stats.timeout++;
1024:           bk7258_boottrace_detail(3,
1025:             (g_stats.last_tx_error & 0xffu) |
1026:             ((g_stats.timeout & 0xffu) << 8) |
1027:             ((g_stats.fifo_full & 0xffu) << 16) |
1028:             ((g_stats.ack_overflow & 0xffu) << 24));
1029:           if (probe != NULL)
1030:             {
1031:               probe->quarantine = true;
1032:               complete_transaction(probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
1033:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
1034:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
1035:             }
1036:           else
1037:             {
1038:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
1039:             }
1040:         }
1041: 
1042:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN &&
1043:           clock_systime_ticks() - g_down_since >= MB_DOWN_RETRY)
1044:         {
1045:           select_recovery_epoch();
1046:         }
1047: 
1048:       (void)dispatch_locked();
1049:       if (g_probe_requested && ack_slots_used() < MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
1050:         {
1051:           g_probe_requested = false;
1052:         }
1053: 
1054:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&
1055:                       g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
1056:                       !g_channels[4].queued && !g_active.busy;
1057:       if (request_probe)
1058:         {
1059:           g_probe_requested = false;
1060:         }
1061: 
1062:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1063: 
1064:       if (request_probe)
1065:         {
1066:           bk7258_mb_uart_request_state();
1067:         }
1068:     }
1069: 
1070:   return OK;
1071: }

1101: int bk7258_mailbox_workers_start(void)
1102: {
1103:   cpu_set_t cpuset;
1104:   int ret;
1105: 
1106:   if (!g_initialized)
1107:     {
1108:       return -EAGAIN;
1109:     }
1110: 
1111:   if (g_workers_started)
1112:     {
1113:       return OK;
1114:     }
1115: 
1116:   ret = wait_secondary_scheduler();
1117:   if (ret < 0)
1118:     {
1119:       return ret;
1120:     }
1121: 
1122: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
1123:   /* All physical CP descriptors must originate on logical CPU0.  Pin the
1124:    * creator before activating the workers so their inherited affinity is
1125:    * CPU0-only from their first scheduled instruction. */
1126: 
1127:   CPU_ZERO(&cpuset);
1128:   CPU_SET(0, &cpuset);
1129:   ret = sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(cpuset), &cpuset);
1130:   if (ret < 0)
1131:     {
1132:       return ret;
1133:     }
1134: #endif
1135: 
1136:   ret = bk7258_timer_start();
1137:   if (ret < 0)
1138:     {
1139:       return ret;
1140:     }
1141: 
1142:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_TIMER_RETURN);
1143: 
1144:   if (!g_tx_worker_created)
1145:     {
1146:       ret = kthread_create("mbox-v2", MB_TX_BOOT_PRIORITY, 2048,
1147:                            mailbox_tx_worker, NULL);
1148:       if (ret < 0)
1149:         {
1150:           return ret;
1151:         }
1152: 
1153:       g_tx_worker_created = true;
1154:       g_tx_worker_pid = ret;
1155:     }
1156: 
1157:   if (!g_diag_worker_created)
1158:     {
1159:       ret = kthread_create("mbox-diag", 80, 1024, mailbox_diag_worker, NULL);
1160:       if (ret < 0)
1161:         {
1162:           return ret;
1163:         }
1164: 
1165:       g_diag_worker_created = true;
1166:     }
1167: 
1168:   g_workers_started = true;
1169:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_TIMER_READY);
1170:   return OK;
1171: }

1210: int bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(uint8_t logical_channel,
1211:                              const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
1212:                              bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback, void *arg)
1213: {
1214:   struct logical_channel *channel;
1215:   unsigned int index;
1216:   irqstate_t flags;
1217: 
1218:   if (!g_initialized || !g_physical_started || message == NULL)
1219:     {
1220:       return -EAGAIN;
1221:     }
1222: 
1223:   index = channel_index(logical_channel);
1224:   if (index >= MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
1225:     {
1226:       return -EINVAL;
1227:     }
1228: 
1229:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1230:   channel = &g_channels[index];
1231: 
1232:   if (is_liveness_channel(logical_channel) &&
1233:       g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN)
1234:     {
1235:       select_recovery_epoch();
1236:     }
1237: 
1238:   /* A console ownership change can leave one UART DATA transaction waiting
1239:    * for an ACK.  Abort that transaction before queueing HW_CTRL/PWC so the
1240:    * liveness path does not inherit the console's timeout. */
1241: 
1242:   if (is_liveness_channel(logical_channel) && g_active.busy &&
1243:       bk7258_mb_header_channel(&g_active.message) ==
1244:       BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX)
1245:     {
1246:       begin_abort(-EAGAIN);
1247:     }
1248:   if (channel->queued)
1249:     {
1250:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1251:       return -EBUSY;
1252:     }
1253: 
1254:   if (g_link_state != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
1255:       !(g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
1256:         logical_channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
1257:         bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE) &&
1258:       !is_liveness_channel(logical_channel))
1259:     {
1260:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1261:       return -ENOLINK;
1262:     }
1263: 
1264:   if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY && g_active.quarantine)
1265:     {
1266:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1267:       return -ENOLINK;
1268:     }
1269: 
1270:   memset(&channel->pending, 0, sizeof(channel->pending));
1271:   memcpy(&channel->pending, message, sizeof(channel->pending));
1272:   channel->callback = callback;
1273:   channel->arg = arg;
1274:   channel->result = -EINPROGRESS;
1275:   channel->queued = true;
1276: 
1277:   if (up_cpu_index() == 0)
1278:     {
1279:       (void)dispatch_locked();
1280:     }
1281: 
1282:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1283: 
1284:   /* CPU1 callers only enqueue work.  Physical descriptors to the CP still
1285:    * originate exclusively from logical CPU0.
1286:    */
1287: 
1288:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
1289:   return OK;
1290: }

1372: int bk7258_mailbox_wait_link_ready(unsigned int timeout_ms)
1373: {
1374:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms);
1375:   clock_t next_probe = clock_systime_ticks();
1376: 
1377:   while (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
1378:     {
1379:       clock_t now = clock_systime_ticks();
1380: 
1381:       if ((int32_t)(clock_systime_ticks() - deadline) >= 0)
1382:         {
1383:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
1384:         }
1385: 
1386:       /* Keep the boot-time probe self-starting even if the initial
1387:        * ABORTING -> PROBING worker wakeup was consumed before RESET was
1388:        * dispatched.  This only marks STATE pending; normal transaction
1389:        * serialization remains in the mailbox workers. */
1390:       if ((int32_t)(now - next_probe) >= 0)
1391:         {
1392:           /* The TX worker can complete STATE between the loop condition and
1393:            * this retry point.  Do not reopen a link that has just become
1394:            * ready. */
1395:           if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
1396:             {
1397:               bk7258_mailbox_start_probe();
1398:               bk7258_mb_uart_request_state();
1399:             }
1400:           next_probe = now + MSEC2TICK(100);
1401:         }
1402: 
1403:       bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
1404:       nxsig_usleep(1000);
1405:     }
1406: 
1407:   return OK;
1408: }

1457: static int wait_channel(uint8_t logical_channel, unsigned int timeout_ms)
1458: {
1459:   unsigned int index = channel_index(logical_channel);
1460:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms);
1461: 
1462:   if (index >= MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
1463:     {
1464:       return -EINVAL;
1465:     }
1466: 
1467:   for (;;)
1468:     {
1469:       irqstate_t flags;
1470:       bool queued;
1471:       int result;
1472: 
1473:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
1474:       queued = g_channels[index].queued;
1475:       result = g_channels[index].result;
1476:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
1477:       if (!queued)
1478:         {
1479:           return result == -EINPROGRESS ? OK : result;
1480:         }
1481: 
1482:       if ((int32_t)(clock_systime_ticks() - deadline) >= 0)
1483:         {
1484:           bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
1485:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
1486:         }
1487: 
1488:       /* UART link bring-up drains the physical mailbox explicitly because
1489:        * the IRQ may not be dispatched while board_late_initialize() owns the
1490:        * boot transaction.  PWC waits run in the same context and need the
1491:        * same progress guarantee; otherwise CP can process 0x5 and enqueue its
1492:        * ACK while AP remains asleep waiting for an IRQ-side drain. */
1493:       bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
1494:       nxsig_usleep(1000);
1495:     }
1496: }
1497:

211:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;

632:   uint16_t first;

634:   if (data == NULL && length != 0)

649:     {
650:       first = written;
651:     }

653:   memcpy(&g_uart.tx_ring[g_uart.tx_write], data, first);
654:   if (first != written)

660:   g_uart.stats.write_calls++;

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 Armino-compatible HW_CTRL power-up and heartbeat service.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <stdio.h>
11: #include <string.h>
12: #include <syslog.h>
13: 
14: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
15: #include <nuttx/kthread.h>
16: #include <nuttx/mutex.h>
17: #include <nuttx/sched.h>
18: #include <nuttx/signal.h>
19: 
20: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
21: #define IPC_CPU1_POWER_UP_INDICATION   1u
22: #define IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION 2u
23: #define IPC_ACK_STATE_COMPLETE         2u
24: #define IPC_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS        600u
25: #define IPC_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL         MSEC2TICK(2000)
26: #define IPC_HEARTBEAT_RETRY            MSEC2TICK(100)
27: #define IPC_HEARTBEAT_POLL_US           10000u
28: #define IPC_HEARTBEAT_PRIORITY          110
29: 
30: static mutex_t g_ipc_lock = NXMUTEX_INITIALIZER;
31: static volatile int g_ipc_ack_result;
32: static volatile int g_ipc_start_result;
33: static volatile int g_heartbeat_result;
34: static volatile bool g_heartbeat_enabled;
35: static volatile bool g_heartbeat_pending;
36: static volatile uint32_t g_heartbeat_completions;
37: static clock_t g_next_heartbeat;
38: static uint32_t g_heartbeat_failures;
39: static uint32_t g_heartbeat_submissions;
40: static uint32_t g_heartbeat_reported;
41: static bool g_ipc_started;
42: 
43: static int bind_worker_to_primary(void)
44: {
45: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
46:   cpu_set_t cpuset;
47: 
48:   CPU_ZERO(&cpuset);
49:   CPU_SET(0, &cpuset);
50:   return sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(cpuset), &cpuset);
51: #else
52:   return OK;
53: #endif
54: }
55: 
56: static int ipc_ack_result(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
57:                           int result)
58: {
59:   if (result == OK &&
60:       (ack == NULL || ack->reserved != IPC_ACK_STATE_COMPLETE))
61:     {
62:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
63:     }
64: 
65:   return result;
66: }
67: 
68: static void ipc_tx_complete(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
69:                               int result, void *arg)
70: {
71:   g_ipc_ack_result = ipc_ack_result(ack, result);
72:   if ((uintptr_t)arg == IPC_CPU1_POWER_UP_INDICATION &&
73:       g_ipc_ack_result == OK)
74:     {
75:       g_heartbeat_result = OK;
76:       g_next_heartbeat = clock_systime_ticks() + IPC_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL;
77:       g_heartbeat_enabled = true;
78:     }
79: }
80: 
81: static void ipc_heartbeat_complete(
82:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack, int result, void *arg)
83: {
84:   (void)arg;
85:   g_heartbeat_result = ipc_ack_result(ack, result);
86:   g_heartbeat_completions++;
87:   g_heartbeat_pending = false;
88: }
89: 
90: static int ipc_send(uint8_t command, uint32_t parameter)
91: {
92:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
93:   volatile uint32_t *payload =
94:     (volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
95:   int ret;
96: 
97:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&g_ipc_lock);
98:   if (ret < 0)
99:     {
100:       return ret;
101:     }
102: 
103:   *payload = parameter;
104:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
105: 
106:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
107:   message.header = command;
108:   message.payload_address = BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
109:   message.payload_length =
110:     command == IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION ? sizeof(*payload) : 0;
111:   g_ipc_ack_result = -EINPROGRESS;
112: 
113:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX, &message,
114:                                   ipc_tx_complete,
115:                                   (void *)(uintptr_t)command);
116:   if (ret == OK)
117:     {
118:       ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_hw_control(IPC_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS);
119:       if (ret == OK)
120:         {
121:           ret = g_ipc_ack_result;
122:         }
123:     }
124: 
125:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_ipc_lock);
126:   return ret > 0 ? -EIO : ret;
127: }
128: 
129: static int ipc_heartbeat_worker(int argc, char **argv)
130: {
131:   int ret;
132: 
133:   (void)argc;
134:   (void)argv;
135: 
136:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
137:   if (ret < 0)
138:     {
139:       return -EXDEV;
140:     }
141: 
142:   for (;;)
143:     {
144:       nxsig_usleep(IPC_HEARTBEAT_POLL_US);
145:       bk7258_ipc_heartbeat_poll();
146:     }
147: 
148:   return OK;
149: }
150: 
151: void bk7258_ipc_heartbeat_poll(void)
152: {
153:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
154:   volatile uint32_t *payload =
155:     (volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
156:   clock_t now;
157:   int ret;
158: 
159:   if (!g_heartbeat_enabled || g_heartbeat_pending)
160:     {
161:       return;
162:     }
163: 
164:   if (g_heartbeat_completions != g_heartbeat_reported)
165:     {
166:       g_heartbeat_reported = g_heartbeat_completions;
167:       if (g_heartbeat_reported <= 3u)
168:         {
169:           printf("IPC: heartbeat ACK result=%d count=%lu\n",
170:                  g_heartbeat_result,
171:                  (unsigned long)g_heartbeat_reported);
172:         }
173:     }
174: 
175:   if (g_heartbeat_result < 0)
176:     {
177:       g_heartbeat_failures++;
178:       if ((g_heartbeat_failures & (g_heartbeat_failures - 1u)) == 0)
179:         {
180:           syslog(LOG_ERR, "IPC heartbeat failed: %d count=%lu\n",
181:                  g_heartbeat_result,
182:                  (unsigned long)g_heartbeat_failures);
183:         }
184: 
185:       g_heartbeat_result = OK;
186:     }
187: 
188:   now = clock_systime_ticks();
189:   if ((sclock_t)(now - g_next_heartbeat) < 0)
190:     {
191:       return;
192:     }
193: 
194:   *payload = 0;
195:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
196:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
197:   message.header = IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION;
198:   message.payload_address = BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
199:   message.payload_length = sizeof(*payload);
200:   g_heartbeat_result = -EINPROGRESS;
201:   g_heartbeat_pending = true;
202:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX, &message,
203:                                  ipc_heartbeat_complete, NULL);
204:   if (ret == OK)
205:     {
206:       g_heartbeat_submissions++;
207:       g_next_heartbeat = now + IPC_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL;
208:       if (g_heartbeat_submissions <= 3u)
209:         {
210:           printf("IPC: heartbeat queued count=%lu tick=%llu\n",
211:                  (unsigned long)g_heartbeat_submissions,
212:                  (unsigned long long)now);
213:         }
214:     }
215:   else
216:     {
217:       g_heartbeat_pending = false;
218:       g_heartbeat_result = ret;
219:       g_next_heartbeat = now + IPC_HEARTBEAT_RETRY;
220:     }
221: }
222: 
223: int bk7258_ipc_heartbeat_start(void)
224: {
225:   int pid;
226:   int ret;
227: 
228:   if (g_ipc_started)
229:     {
230:       return g_ipc_start_result;
231:     }
232: 
233:   g_ipc_start_result = -EINPROGRESS;
234:   g_heartbeat_enabled = false;
235:   g_heartbeat_pending = false;
236:   g_heartbeat_completions = 0;
237:   g_heartbeat_failures = 0;
238:   g_heartbeat_submissions = 0;
239:   g_heartbeat_reported = 0;
240:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
241:   if (ret < 0)
242:     {
243:       g_ipc_start_result = -EXDEV;
244:     }
245:   else
246:     {
247:       ret = ipc_send(IPC_CPU1_POWER_UP_INDICATION, 0);
248:       g_ipc_start_result = ret < 0 ? ret : OK;
249:     }
250: 
251:   if (g_ipc_start_result == OK)
252:     {
253:       pid = kthread_create("ipc-heartbeat", IPC_HEARTBEAT_PRIORITY, 1536,
254:                            ipc_heartbeat_worker, NULL);
255:       if (pid < 0)
256:         {
257:           g_ipc_start_result = pid;
258:         }
259:     }
260: 
261:   g_ipc_started = g_ipc_start_result == OK;
262: 
263:   if (g_ipc_start_result == OK)
264:     {
265:       printf("IPC: HW_CTRL power-up acknowledged by CP, heartbeat armed "
266:              "now=%llu deadline=%llu\n",
267:              (unsigned long long)clock_systime_ticks(),
268:              (unsigned long long)g_next_heartbeat);
269:     }
270: 
271:   return g_ipc_start_result;
272: }

303: static int pwc_rx(const void *raw)
304: {
305:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
306:   struct pwc_message message;
307:   unsigned int next;
308: 
309:   if (bytes == NULL)
310:     {
311:       return -EINVAL;
312:     }
313: 
314:   /* The logical mailbox invokes PWC callbacks while holding the driver lock.
315:    * Keep the queue update in that critical section instead of recursively
316:    * acquiring the non-recursive SMP spinlock here. */
317: 
318:   next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
319:   if (next == g_tail)
320:     {
321:       return -EAGAIN;
322:     }
323: 
324:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
325:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
326:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
327:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
328:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
329:   g_head = next;
330:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
331:   return OK;
332: }

334: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
335: {
336:   int ret;
337: 
338:   (void)argc;
339:   (void)argv;
340:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
341:   g_worker_result = ret < 0 ? -EXDEV : OK;
342:   g_worker_ready = ret >= 0;
343:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
344:   if (ret < 0)
345:     {
346:       return -EXDEV;
347:     }
348: 
349:   for (;;)
350:     {
351:       struct pwc_message message;
352:       irqstate_t flags;
353: 
354:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
355:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
356:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
357:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
358:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
359:       /* A full software queue leaves the physical descriptor deferred with
360:        * no transport ACK.  Freeing one entry is the progress event that must
361:        * retry that descriptor even when no new mailbox IRQ arrives. */
362: 
363:       bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
364:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
365:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
366:         {
367:           case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:
368:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
369:             if (g_psram_power_waiting &&
370:                 message.param1 == g_psram_power_expected_state)
371:               {
372:                 g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
373:                 g_psram_power_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
374:                 g_psram_power_version = message.param3;
375:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
376:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
377:               }
378:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
379:             break;
380: 
381:           case PM_OPENVELA_READY_CMD:
382:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
383:             if (g_openvela_ready_waiting &&
384:                 message.param1 == g_openvela_ready_expected)
385:               {
386:                 g_openvela_ready_echo = message.param1;
387:                 g_openvela_ready_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
388:                 g_openvela_ready_version = message.param3;
389:                 g_openvela_ready_received = true;
390:                 g_openvela_ready_waiting = false;
391:                 nxsem_post(&g_openvela_ready_sem);
392:               }
393:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
394:             break;
395: 
396: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
397:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
398:             if (message.param1 == 0u)
399:               {
400:                 ret = pwc_send_wait(PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
401:                                     PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
402:                                     bk7258_psram_heap_used(), 0);
403:                 if (ret != OK)
404:                   {
405:                     printf("PWC: PSRAM malloc state response failed, "
406:                            "error=%d\n", ret);
407:                   }
408:               }
409:             else if (message.param1 == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
410:               {
411:                 /* This CP notification is sent after physical power-down. */
412: 
413:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();
414:               }
415:             break;
416: 
417:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:
418:             bk7258_psram_dump();
419:             break;
420: 
421:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
422:             {
423: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
424:               ret = pwc_send_wait(PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD,
425:                                   PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT,
426:                                   (uint32_t)-ENOTSUP, 0);
427: #else
428:               int shutdown_ret = bk7258_psram_shutdown();
429: 
430:               ret = pwc_send_wait(
431:                       PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
432:                       shutdown_ret == 0 ? PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH :
433:                                           PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT, 0);
434: #endif
435:               if (ret != OK)
436:                 {
437:                   printf("PWC: recovery response failed, error=%d\n", ret);
438:                 }
439:             }
440:             break;
441: #endif
442: 
443:           default:
444:             break;
445:         }
446:     }
447:   return 0;
448: }

175:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
176:   unsigned int i;
177: 
178:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
179:     {
180:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
181: 
182:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
183:         {
184:           continue;
185:         }
186: 
187:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
188:         {
189:           oldest = desc;
190:         }
191:     }
192: 
193:   return oldest;
194: }
195: 
196: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
197: {
198:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
199:   int ret;
200: 
201:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
202:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
203:    */
204: 
205:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
206:     {
207:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
208:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
209:       g_processing_order = 0;
210:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
211:         {
212:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
213:           break;
214:         }
215: 
216:       desc->used = false;
217:     }
218: 
219:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
220:     {
221:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
222:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
223:       g_processing_order = 0;
224:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
225:         {
226:           break;
227:         }
228: 
229:       desc->used = false;
230:     }
231: }
232: 
233: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
234: {
235:   uintptr_t rdata0;
236:   uintptr_t rdata1;
237:   uintptr_t sidreg;
238:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
239:   unsigned int budget = MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET;
240: 
241:   (void)irq;
242:   (void)context;
243:   (void)arg;
244: 
245:   mbox_clear_errors(cpu);
246:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() >=
247:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_ACK &&
248:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() <
249:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER)
250:     {
251:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_ENTER);
252:     }
253:   sidreg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_SID : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_SID;
254:   rdata0 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA0;
255:   rdata1 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA1;
256: 
257:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0 && budget-- != 0)
258:     {
259:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
260:       uint32_t address;
261:       uint32_t length;
262:       uint8_t source;
263: 
264:       if (cpu == 0)
265:         {
266:           mbox_process_desc();
267:         }
268: 
269:       desc = cpu == 0 ? mbox_alloc_desc() : NULL;
270:       if (cpu == 0 && desc == NULL)
271:         {
272:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
273:           mbox_trace_errors();
274:           break;
275:         }
276: 
277:       source = getreg32(sidreg) & 0x0fu;
278:       address = getreg32(rdata0);
279:       length = getreg32(rdata1);
280: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
281:       if (length == 0)
282:         {
283:           if (source == (uint8_t)(2 - cpu))
284:             {
285:               if (cpu == 1 && address == BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK)
286:                 {
287:                   bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW);
288:                 }
289: 
290:               bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(irq, context, address);
291:             }
292:           else
293:             {
294:               if (cpu == 0)
295:                 {
296:                   g_stats.bad_source++;
297:                   mbox_trace_errors();
298:                 }
299:             }
300: 
301:           continue;
302:         }
303: #endif
304: 
305:       if (cpu != 0)
306:         {
307:           continue;
308:         }
309: 
310:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
311:         {
312:           continue;
313:         }
314: 
315:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
316:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
317:              sizeof(desc->message));
318:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
319:       desc->used = true;
320:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
321:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, desc->message.header);
322:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, address);
323:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.rx_messages);
324:       mbox_process_desc();
325:     }
326: 
327:   if (cpu == 0)
328:     {
329:       mbox_process_desc();
330:     }
331: 
332:   if (cpu == 1 && bk7258_boottrace_secondary_stage() ==
333:                   BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_RAW)
334:     {
335:       bk7258_boottrace_secondary(BK7258_BOOT_SECONDARY_MBOX_EXIT);
336:     }
337: 
338:   return OK;
339: }

341: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback)
342: {
343:   g_callback = callback;
344: }

346: void bk7258_mbox_kick_rx(void)
347: {
348:   irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
349: 
350:   (void)bk7258_mbox_irq(0, NULL, NULL);
351:   up_irq_restore(flags);

354: void bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred(void)
355: {
356:   unsigned int i;
357: 
358:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
359:     {
360:       if (g_rx_desc[i].used && g_processing_order != 0 &&
361:           (int32_t)(g_rx_desc[i].order - g_processing_order) < 0 &&
362:           !mbox_priority_message(&g_rx_desc[i].message))
363:         {
364:           g_rx_desc[i].used = false;
365:         }
366:     }
367: }

369: void bk7258_mbox_get_stats(struct bk7258_mbox_stats *stats)
370: {
371:   irqstate_t flags;
372: 
373:   if (stats == NULL)
374:     {
375:       return;
376:     }
377: 
378:   flags = up_irq_save();
379:   *stats = g_stats;
380:   up_irq_restore(flags);
381: }
382: 
383: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
384: {
385:   int ret;
386: 
387:   if (g_mbox_ready)
388:     {
389:       return OK;
390:     }
391: 
392:   memset(g_rx_desc, 0, sizeof(g_rx_desc));
393:   g_rx_order = 0;
394:   g_processing_order = 0;
395:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));
396: 
397:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
398:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
399:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.
400:    */
401: 
402:   putreg32(2u | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
403:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
404:             BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG);
405:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
406: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
407:   putreg32(5u | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
408:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
409:             BK7258_MBOX_CH2_CFG);
410:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH2_FIFO_CFG);
411: #endif
412:   modifyreg32(BK7258_MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
413:   mbox_clear_errors(0);
414: 
415:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
416:   if (ret < 0)
417:     {
418:       return ret;
419:     }
420: 
421:   g_mbox_ready = true;
422: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
423:   g_mbox_smp_ready = true;
424: #endif
425:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
426:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
427:   return OK;
428: }

431: {
432: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
433:   return g_mbox_ready && g_mbox_smp_ready;

435:   return false;
436: #endif
437: }

445:     }

27: #define BK7258_KEY_DEBOUNCE_COUNT 6
28: #define BK7258_MOTOR_FREQUENCY   1000
29: #define BK7258_MOTOR_DUTY        ((ub16_t)((7u * 65536u) / 10u))
30: #define BK7258_PM_CLK_CTRL_CMD   2
31: #define BK7258_PM_CLK_ID_PWM_1   3
32: #define BK7258_PM_CLK_POWER_UP   1

34: struct pwm_lowerhalf_s *bk7258_pwminitialize(void);

39: static sem_t g_motor_ready_sem;

42: static int bind_worker_to_primary(void)
43: {
44: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
45:   cpu_set_t cpuset;
46: 
47:   CPU_ZERO(&cpuset);
48:   CPU_SET(0, &cpuset);
49:   return sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(cpuset), &cpuset);
50: #else
51:   return OK;
52: #endif

55: static int bk7258_motor_button_worker(int argc, char **argv)
56: {
57:   struct pwm_info_s info =
58:   {
59:     .frequency = BK7258_MOTOR_FREQUENCY,
60:     .duty = BK7258_MOTOR_DUTY,
61:   };
62:   bool candidate = false;
63:   bool pressed = false;
64:   unsigned int samples = 0;
65:   int fd;
66: 
67:   (void)argc;
68:   (void)argv;
69:   fd = bind_worker_to_primary();
70:   g_motor_worker_result = fd < 0 ? -EXDEV : OK;
71:   nxsem_post(&g_motor_ready_sem);
72:   if (fd < 0)
73:     {
74:       return -EXDEV;
75:     }
76: 
77:   fd = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(BK7258_PM_CLK_CTRL_CMD,
78:                                BK7258_PM_CLK_ID_PWM_1,
79:                                BK7258_PM_CLK_POWER_UP, 0);
80:   if (fd < 0)
81:     {
82:       syslog(LOG_ERR, "power-key motor: PWM clock request failed: %d\n", fd);
83:       return fd;
84:     }
85: 
86:   /* 当前 PWC 仅入队请求，不等待 CP 语义响应。PWM0 时钟门控由 CP 收到
87:    * mailbox 命令后才打开，此处延时等待 CP 完成时钟使能，避免后续 PWM
88:    * 寄存器写入因时钟未就绪而丢失。待 PWC worker 补上 ACK 消费后应改为
89:    * 有界等待。
90:    */
91:   nxsig_usleep(20000);
92:   fd = open("/dev/pwm0", O_RDWR);
93:   if (fd < 0)
94:     {
95:       syslog(LOG_ERR, "power-key motor: open pwm0 failed: %d\n", -errno);
96:       return -errno;
97:     }
98: 
99:   if (ioctl(fd, PWMIOC_SETCHARACTERISTICS,
100:             (unsigned long)(uintptr_t)&info) < 0)
101:     {
102:       int ret = -errno;
103:       syslog(LOG_ERR, "power-key motor: set PWM characteristics failed: %d\n",
104:              ret);
105:       close(fd);
106:       return ret;
107:     }
108: 
109:   printf("power-key motor worker ready, PWM parameters applied\n");
110: 
111:   for (;;)
112:     {
113:       bool sample = (board_buttons() & BUTTON_POWER_BIT) != 0;
114: 
115:       if (sample != candidate)
116:         {
117:           candidate = sample;
118:           samples = 1;
119:         }
120:       else if (samples < BK7258_KEY_DEBOUNCE_COUNT)
121:         {
122:           samples++;
123:         }
124: 
125:       if (samples == BK7258_KEY_DEBOUNCE_COUNT && pressed != candidate)
126:         {
127:           int cmd = candidate ? PWMIOC_START : PWMIOC_STOP;
128: 
129:           syslog(LOG_INFO, "power-key motor: button=%u, pwm cmd=%d\n",
130:                  candidate, cmd);
131:           if (ioctl(fd, cmd, 0) < 0)
132:             {
133:               syslog(LOG_ERR, "power-key motor: PWM cmd=%d failed: %d\n",
134:                      cmd, -errno);
135:               close(fd);
136:               return -errno;
137:             }
138: 
139:           pressed = candidate;
140:         }
141: 
142:       nxsig_usleep(BK7258_KEY_POLL_US);
143:     }
144: }
145: #endif

195: #endif

5: #include <nuttx/config.h>

7: #include <limits.h>
8: #include <stddef.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>

11:

13: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
14: 
15: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
16: 
17: #define BK7258_SYSLOG_FORCE_TIMEOUT_MS 20u
18: 
19: static int bk7258_syslog_putc(syslog_channel_t *channel, int ch)
20: {
21:   uint8_t byte = ch;
22: 
23:   (void)channel;
24:   return bk7258_mbox_uart_write(&byte, 1) == 1 ? ch : EOF;
25: }
26: 
27: static int bk7258_syslog_force(syslog_channel_t *channel, int ch)
28: {
29:   int ret = bk7258_syslog_putc(channel, ch);
30: 
31:   if (ret != EOF && !up_interrupt_context())
32:     {
33:       (void)bk7258_mbox_uart_flush(BK7258_SYSLOG_FORCE_TIMEOUT_MS);
34:     }
35: 
36:   return ret;
37: }
38: 
39: static ssize_t bk7258_syslog_write(syslog_channel_t *channel,
40:                                    const char *buffer, size_t length)
41: {
42:   size_t total = 0;
43: 
44:   (void)channel;
45:   while (total < length)
46:     {
47:       size_t chunk = length - total;
48:       ssize_t ret;
49: 
50:       if (chunk > UINT16_MAX)
51:         {
52:           chunk = UINT16_MAX;
53:         }
54: 
55:       ret = bk7258_mbox_uart_write((const uint8_t *)buffer + total, chunk);
56:       if (ret <= 0)
57:         {
58:           return total != 0 ? (ssize_t)total : ret;
59:         }
60: 
61:       total += ret;
62:       if ((size_t)ret < chunk)
63:         {
64:           break;
65:         }
66:     }
67: 
68:   return total;
69: }
70: 
71: static ssize_t bk7258_syslog_write_force(syslog_channel_t *channel,
72:                                          const char *buffer, size_t length)
73: {
74:   ssize_t ret = bk7258_syslog_write(channel, buffer, length);
75: 
76:   if (ret > 0 && !up_interrupt_context())
77:     {
78:       (void)bk7258_mbox_uart_flush(BK7258_SYSLOG_FORCE_TIMEOUT_MS);
79:     }
80: 
81:   return ret;
82: }
83: 
84: static int bk7258_syslog_flush(syslog_channel_t *channel)
85: {
86:   (void)channel;
87:   if (up_interrupt_context())
88:     {
89:       return -EAGAIN;
90:     }
91: 
92:   return bk7258_mbox_uart_flush(BK7258_SYSLOG_FORCE_TIMEOUT_MS);
93: }
94: 
95: static const struct syslog_channel_ops_s g_bk7258_syslog_ops =
96: {
97:   .sc_putc = bk7258_syslog_putc,
98:   .sc_force = bk7258_syslog_force,
99:   .sc_flush = bk7258_syslog_flush,
100:   .sc_write = bk7258_syslog_write,
101:   .sc_write_force = bk7258_syslog_write_force,
102:   .sc_close = NULL,
103: };
104: 
105: static syslog_channel_t g_bk7258_syslog_channel =
106: {
107:   .sc_ops = &g_bk7258_syslog_ops,
108: };
109: 
110: int bk7258_syslog_initialize(void)
111: {
112:   bk7258_mbox_uart_early_init();
113:   return syslog_channel_register(&g_bk7258_syslog_channel);
114: }

214: static inline bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send_safe(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
215: {

217: 
218: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();

225: static bool mb_chnl_rx_ready(void)
226: {
227: 	/* Keep one ACK slot available for the command currently being handled.
228: 	 * A command must not be consumed and its business callback run if its
229: 	 * transport ACK cannot be queued. */
230: 	return ack_count < MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN - 1;
231: }

233: static void mb_chnl_ack_retry(void)
234: {
235: 	u16 chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
236: 
237: 	while (1)
238: 	{
239: 		mb_ack_entry_t entry;
240: 		bk_err_t ret;
241: 		u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
242: 
243: 		if (!ack_count || ack_sending)
244: 		{
245: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
246: 			return;
247: 		}
248: 		entry = ack_queue[ack_read];
249: 		ack_sending = 1;
250: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
251: 
252: 		ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry.data, SELF_CPU,
253: 			(mailbox_endpoint_t)entry.destination, &chnl_type);
254: 		flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
255: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
256: 		{
257: 			phy_chnl_x_cb[entry.destination].ack_retry_cnt++;
258: 			ack_sending = 0;
259: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
260: 			return;
261: 		}
262: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
263: 		ack_count--;
264: 		ack_sending = 0;
265: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
266: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
267: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry.destination],
268: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry.destination],
269: 			MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);
270: 	}
271: }
272: 
273: static bool mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(u8 destination, const mailbox_data_t *data)
274: {
275: 	u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
276: 	mb_ack_entry_t *entry;
277: 
278: 	if (ack_count >= MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN - 1)
279: 	{
280: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[destination].ack_queue_full_cnt++;
281: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
282: 		return false;
283: 	}
284: 	entry = &ack_queue[ack_write];
285: 	entry->data = *data;
286: 	entry->destination = destination;
287: 	ack_write = (ack_write + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
288: 	ack_count++;
289: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
290: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
291: 	return true;
292: }

337: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
338: {
339: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
340: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
341: 	u16 			chnl_type;
342: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
343: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
344: 
345: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
346: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
347: 
348: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
349: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
350: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
351: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
352: #endif
353: 
354: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
355: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
356: 
357: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
358: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
359: 
360: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
361: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
362: 
363: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
364: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
365: 
366: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
367: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
368: 
369: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
370: 
371: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
372: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
373: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
374: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
375: 
376: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
377: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_cmd_header = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
378: 
379: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
380: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
381: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
382: 
383: 	__DMB();
384: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
385: 
386: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
387: 
388: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
389: 
390: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
391: 	{
392: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
393: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
394: 
395: 		return ret_code;
396: 	}
397: 
398: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
399: 
400: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
401: 
402: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
403: 	{
404: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
405: 	}
406: 
407: 	return BK_OK;
408: }

410: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
411: {
412: 	u8		log_chnl;
413: 	u8		ret_code;
414: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
415: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
416: 
417: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
418: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
419: 
420: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
421: 	if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
422: 	{
423: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
424: 
425: 		phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);
426: 		if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != (CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX | CHNL_CTRL_RESET) ||
427: 			ack_ptr->hdr.state != 0 || ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != 0 ||
428: 			ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != 0 || ack_ptr->data1 != 0 ||
429: 			ack_ptr->data2 != 0 || ack_ptr->data3 != 0 ||
430: 			GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl) != SELF_CPU ||
431: 			phy_chnl_idx == SELF_CPU || phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
432: 		{
433: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
434: 			if (phy_chnl_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM)
435: 				phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx].reset_bad_cnt++;
436: 			return;
437: 		}
438: 
439: 		phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
440: 		phy_chnl_ptr->recovering = 1;
441: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx];
442: 		mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x,
443: 				   phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
444: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
445: 		u32 reset_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
446: 		if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY)
447: 		{
448: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
449: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
450: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
451: 			log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
452: 			if (log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx] &&
453: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
454: 			{
455: 				memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
456: 				failure.hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
457: 				failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
458: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(
459: 					log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, &failure);
460: 			}
461: 			bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
462: 		}
463: 		else
464: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
465: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(log_chnl_cb_x,
466: 				     phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]);
467: 		return;
468: 	}
469: 
470: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
471: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
472: 
473: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
474: 
475: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
476: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
477: 		return;
478: 	}
479: 
480: 
481: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
482: 	{
483: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
484: 		return;
485: 	}
486: 
487: 
488: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
489: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
490: 		return;
491: 	}
492: 
493: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
494: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_ack_header = ack_ptr->hdr.data;
495: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_ack_data1 = ack_ptr->data1;
496: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
497: 
498: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
499: 	{
500: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
501: 		return;
502: 	}
503: 
504: 	u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
505: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY ||
506: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) ||
507: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.state & ~CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) ||
508: 		 (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
509: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) ||
510: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd))
511: 	{
512: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
513: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
514: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
515: 		return;
516: 	}
517: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
518: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
519: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
520: 
521: 	bk_mailbox_tx_complete((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
522: 
523: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
524: 	{
525: 		/* clear following header members. */
526: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
527: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
528: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
529: 
530: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
531: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
532: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
533: 	} else {
534: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
535: 	}
536: 
537: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
538: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
539: 	{
540: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
541: 		return;
542: 	}
543: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
544: 	{
545: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
546: 			break;
547: 	}
548: 
549: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
550: 	{
551: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
552: 		return;
553: 	}
554: 
555: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
556: 
557: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
558: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
559: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
560: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
561: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
562: 
563: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
564: 
565: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
566: 	{
567: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
568: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
569: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
570: 	}
571: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
572: 
573: 	return;
574: 
575: }

577: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
578: {
579: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
580: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
581: 
582: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
583: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
584: 
585: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
586: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
587: 
588: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
589: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
590: 
591: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
592: 
593: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
594: 		return;
595: 
596: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
597: 		return;
598: 
599: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
600: 		return;
601: 
602: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
603: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
604: 
605: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
606: 
607: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
608: 	{
609: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
610: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
611: 
612: 		return;
613: 	}
614: 
615: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr != NULL)
616: 	{
617: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
618: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
619: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
620: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
621: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
622: 
623: 		if (log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr(
624: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param,
625: 			(mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr) != BK_OK)
626: 			chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
627: 	}
628: 	else if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
629: 	{
630: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
631: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
632: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
633: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
634: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
635: 
636: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
637: 
638: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
639: 	}
640: 	else
641: 	{
642: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
643: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
644: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
645: 	}
646: 
647: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
648: 	{
649: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
650: 		return;
651: 	}
652: 
653: 	/* RE-USE the copied command buffer to construct the stable ACK. */
654: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
655: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
656: 
657: 	if (!mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(phy_chnl_idx, (mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr))
658: 	{
659: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
660: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
661: 		return;
662: 	}
663: 	return;
664: }

666: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
667: {
668: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
669: 
670: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
671: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
672: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
673: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
674: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
675: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
676: 
677: 	/*
678: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
679: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
680: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
681: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
682: 	 */
683: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
684: 	{
685: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
686: 	}
687: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
688: 	{
689: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
690: 	}
691: }

693: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
694: {
695: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
696: 
697: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
698: 
699: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
700: 
701: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
702: 
703: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
704: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
705: 
706: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
707: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
708: 
709: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
710: 
711: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
712: 	{
713: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
714: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
715: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
716: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
717: 
718: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
719: 
720: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
721: 		{
722: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
723: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
724: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
725: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
726: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
727: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
728: 
729: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
730: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
731: 			}
732: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
733: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
734: 			return ret_code;
735: 		}
736: 	}
737: 
738: 	return BK_OK;
739: }

741: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
742: 
743: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
744: {
745: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
746: 	u16 			chnl_type;
747: 
748: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
749: 
750: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
751: 
752: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
753: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
754: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
755: #endif
756: 
757: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
758: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
759: 
760: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
761: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
762: 
763: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
764: 
765: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
766: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
767: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
768: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
769: 
770: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
771: 
772: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
773: 
774: 	/*
775: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
776: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
777: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
778: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
779: 	 */
780: 	while(1)
781: 	{
782: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
783: 
784: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
785: 		{
786: 			break;
787: 		}
788: 	}
789: 
790: 	return ret_code;
791: }

794: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
795: /*
796:   * init logical chnanel module.
797:   * return:
798:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
799:   *     failed  : fail code.
800:   *
801:   */
802: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
803: {
804: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
805: 	int				i, j;
806: 
807: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
808: 
809: 	/*
810: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
811: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
812: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
813: 	 * can race here:
814: 	 *
815: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
816: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
817: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
818: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
819: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
820: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
821: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
822: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
823: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
824: 	 *
825: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
826: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
827: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
828: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
829: 	 */
830: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
831: 	{
832: 		return BK_OK;
833: 	}
834: 
835: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
836: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
837: 	{
838: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
839: 		return BK_OK;
840: 	}
841: 
842: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
843: 	memset(ack_queue, 0, sizeof(ack_queue));
844: 	ack_read = 0;
845: 	ack_write = 0;
846: 	ack_count = 0;
847: 	ack_sending = 0;
848: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
849: 	{
850: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
851: 
852: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
853: 
854: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
855: 
856: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
857: 		{
858: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
859: 		}
860: 	}
861: 
862: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
863: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
864: 	{
865: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
866: 		return ret_code;
867: 	}
868: 
869: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
870: 
871: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
872: 	{
873: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
874: 
875: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
876: 	}
877: 
878: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
879: 	bk_mailbox_rx_ready_callback_register(mb_chnl_rx_ready);
880: 
881: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
882: 
883: 	return BK_OK;
884: }

998: /*
999:   * write to logical chnanel.
1000:   * input:
1001:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to write.
1002:   *     cmd_buf     : buffer of channel cmd data.
1003:   * return:
1004:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
1005:   *     failed  : fail code.
1006:   *
1007:   */
1008: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf)
1009: {
1010: 	u16		write_len;
1011: 
1012: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
1013: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
1014: 
1015: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
1016: 
1017: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
1018: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
1019: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1020: #endif
1021: 
1022: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
1023: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1024: 
1025: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
1026: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1027: 
1028: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
1029: 
1030: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
1031: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1032: 
1033: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
1034: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
1035: 
1036: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1037: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
1038: 	mb_chnl_cmd_t *logical_cmd = cmd_buf;
1039: 
1040: 	if (phy->recovering &&
1041: 		!(log_chnl == MB_CHNL_UART0 &&
1042: 		  logical_cmd->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_STATE_COMMAND))
1043: 	{
1044: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1045: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1046: 	}
1047: 
1048: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
1049: 	{
1050: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1051: 
1052: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1053: 	}
1054: 
1055: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
1056: 
1057: 	memset(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, 0,
1058: 	       sizeof(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff));
1059: 	memcpy(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, cmd_buf, write_len);
1060: 
1061: 	/* set to BUSY means there is data in tx-buff. mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr will get it to send. */
1062: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */
1063: 	__DMB();
1064: 
1065: 	bk_err_t start_ret = mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(log_chnl);
1066: 
1067: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1068: 
1069: 	return start_ret;
1070: }

1083: bk_err_t mb_chnl_ctrl(u8 log_chnl, u8 cmd, void * param)

1086: 
1087: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
1088: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
1089: 
1090: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
1091: 
1092: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
1093: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
1094: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1095: #endif
1096: 
1097: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
1098: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1099: 
1100: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
1101: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1102: 
1103: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
1104: 
1105: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])

1107: 
1108: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
1109: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;

1111: 	switch(cmd)
1112: 	{
