1114: 
1115: 			if(param == NULL)
1116: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
1117: 
1118: 			*((u8 *)param) = log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state;
1119: 
1120: 			break;
1121: 
1122: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR:
1123: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr = (chnl_rx_isr_t)param;
1124: 			break;
1125: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_RX_STATUS_ISR:
1126: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr =
1127: 				(chnl_rx_status_isr_t)param;
1128: 			break;
1129: 
1130: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR:
1131: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr = (chnl_tx_isr_t)param;
1132: 			break;
1133: 
1134: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR:
1135: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr = (chnl_tx_cmpl_isr_t)param;
1136: 			break;
1137: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR:
1138: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].event_isr = (chnl_event_isr_t)param;
1139: 			break;
1140: 
1141: 		case MB_CHNL_WRITE_SYNC:
1142: 			if(param == NULL)
1143: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
1144: 
1145: 			ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(log_chnl, (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)param);
1146: 			return ret_code;
1147: 			break;
1148: 
1149: 		default:
1150: 			return BK_ERR_NOT_SUPPORT;
1151: 			break;
1152: 	}
1153: 
1154: 	return BK_OK;

1157: void mb_chnl_poll(void)
1158: {
1159: 	u8 phy_idx;
1160: 	u32 poll_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1161:

223: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
224: {
225: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
226: 
227: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
228: 
229: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
230: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
231: 
232: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
233: 	{
234: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
235: 	}
236: 	else
237: 	{
238: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
239: 	}
240: 
241: 	if(!mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, true))
242: 	{
243: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
244: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
245: 		tx_fail = 1;
246: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
247: 	}
248: 
249: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
250: 	{
251: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
252: 		tx_fail = 1;
253: 
254: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
255: 	}
256: 
257: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
258: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
259: 	#endif
260: 
261: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
262: 
263: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
264: 
265: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
266: 	{
267: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
268: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
269: 	}
270: 	else
271: 	{
272: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
273: 
274: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
275: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
276: 
277: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
278: 		{
279: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
280: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
281: 		}
282: 		else
283: 		{
284: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
285: 
286: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
287: 			{
288: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
289: 			}
290: 
291: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
292: 		}
293: 	}
294: 
295: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
296: 
297: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
298: 	{
299: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
300: 	}
301: 
302: rx_isr_data_xit:
303: 
304: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
305: 	{
306: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
307: 	}
308: 
309: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
310: 
311: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
312: 
313: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
314: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
315: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
316: 	 */
317: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
318: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
319: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
320: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
321: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
322: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
323: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
324: 
325: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
326: 	{
327: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
328: 		{
329: 			/* trigger send! */
330: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
331: 		}
332: 	}
333: 
334: 	return;
335: }

337: static void rx_isr_state_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd)
338: {

340: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
341: 	u8 invalid = !mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, false);

348: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;

352: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
353: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
354: 	 */
355: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;

362: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)

374: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
375: {
376: 	/* The response carries the current RTS state, but it cannot replace an
377: 	 * outstanding ACK-pool fence.
378: 	 */
379: 	if (!chnl_cb->tx_fence_req)
380: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
381: 
382: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
383: 	{
384: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
385: 	}
386: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
387: 	{
388: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
389: 	}
390: 	else
391: 	{
392: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
393: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
394: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
395: 		 */
396: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
397: 		u8 cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
398: 		memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
399: 		uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
400: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
401: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
402: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
403: 	}
404: 
405: 	return;
406: }

408: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
409: {
410: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
411: 
412: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
413: 
414: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
415: 
416: 	if ((ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) ||
417: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
418: 	{
419: 		chnl_cb->bad_ack_count++;
420: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
421: 		return;
422: 	}
423: 
424: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
425: 
426: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
427: 	{
428: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
429: 	}
430: 	else if ((uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data1 & ~0x3u) ||
431: 		 uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data2 || uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data3)
432: 	{
433: 		tx_fail = 1;
434: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
435: 	}
436: 	else
437: 	{
438: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
439: 	}
440: 
441: 	if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
442: 	{
443: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx + chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
444: 					 sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
445: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
446: 		chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
447: 	}
448: 	else if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
449: 	{
450: 		chnl_cb->tx_fence_req = 0;
451: 		if (!chnl_cb->link_ready)
452: 		{
453: 			chnl_cb->link_ready = 1;
454: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_READY;
455: 			chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
456: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_READY);
457: 		}
458: 	}
459: 
460: 	if (tx_fail)
461: 	{
462: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
463: 		{
464: 			if (chnl_cb->tx_retry)
465: 			{
466: 				chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
467: 						      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
468: 						     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
469: 				chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
470: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
471: 			}
472: 			else
473: 			{
474: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 1;
475: 			}
476: 		}
477: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
478: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
479: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;
480: 		if (chnl_cb->probe_count < MB_UART_PROBE_MAX)
481: 		{
482: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
483: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() + MB_UART_PROBE_RETRY_MS;
484: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
485: 		}
486: 		else
487: 		{
488: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
489: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
490: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() +
491: 				MB_UART_DOWN_RETRY_MS;
492: 		}
493: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
494: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
495: 			chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
496: 		return;
497: 	}
498: 
499: 	/* try next Tx. */
500: 
501: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
502: 
503: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
504: 	{
505: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
506: 		if (ret_val == BK_OK)
507: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
508: 	}
509: 	if (ret_val != BK_OK)
510: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
511: 
512: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
513: 	{
514: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
515: 	}
516: 
517: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
518: 	{
519: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
520: 	}
521: 
522: 	return;
523: }

525: static void mb_uart_channel_event(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_event_t event)
526: {
527: 	if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT)
528: 	{
529: 		u8 peer = GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id);
530: 
531: 		if (!chnl_cb->tx_fence_req &&
532: 			bk_mailbox_ack_slots_used((mailbox_endpoint_t)peer) >=
533: 			MB_UART_ACK_FENCE_WATERMARK)
534: 		{
535: 			chnl_cb->tx_fence_req = 1;
536: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
537: 		}
538: 	}
539: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_SENT)
540: 	{
541: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
542: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
543: 		chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
544: 		chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time();
545: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
546: 	}
547: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_FAILED)
548: 	{
549: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
550: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
551: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
552: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
553: 	}
554: 	else
555: 	{
556: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len)
557: 		{
558: 			/* Delivery is unknowable after a lost ACK. Drop this chunk instead
559: 			 * of replaying terminal input and making duplicate commands. */
560: 			chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
561: 					      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
562: 					     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
563: 			chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
564: 			chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
565: 			chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
566: 		}
567: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
568: 		chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
569: 		chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time();
570: 		chnl_cb->link_state = event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_TX_TIMEOUT ?
571: 			MB_UART_LINK_ABORTING : MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
572: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET;
573: 		if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET)
574: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
575: 		else
576: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_TIMEOUT);
577: 	}
578: 
579: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
580: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
581: }

640: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
641: {
642: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
643: 
644: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
645: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
646: 
647: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
648: 	{
649: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
650: 	}
651: 
652: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
653: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
654: 
655: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
656: 	{
657: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
658: 	}
659: 	else
660: 	{
661: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
662: 	}
663: 
664: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
665: 	{
666: 		return BK_FAIL;
667: 	}
668: 
669: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
670: 	{
671: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
672: 	}
673: 
674: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
675: 	{
676: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
677: 	}
678: 	else
679: 	{
680: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
681: 
682: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
683: 		{
684: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
685: 		}
686: 		else
687: 		{
688: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
689: 
690: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);
691: 		}
692: 	}
693: 
694: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
695: 
696: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
697: 
698: 	memset(&uart_cmd, 0, sizeof(uart_cmd));
699: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
700: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = (void *)(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff);
701: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;
702: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
703: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
704: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = cal_crc8_0x31(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, cpy_len);
705: 
706: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
707: 
708: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
709: 	{
710: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = cpy_len;
711: 	}
712: 
713: 	return ret_val;
714: }

716: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data_trigger(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
717: {
718: 	u32 flag = mb_uart_enter_critical();
719: 
720: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_in_process != 0)
721: 	{
722: 		mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
723: 		return BK_OK;
724: 	}
725: 
726: 	chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 1;
727: 
728: 	mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
729: 
730: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
731: 
732: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
733: 
734: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
735: 	{
736: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
737: 	}
738: 
739: 	return ret_val;
740: }

742: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_state(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
743: {
744: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
745: 
746: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_STATE;
747: 
748: 	memset(&uart_cmd, 0, sizeof(uart_cmd));
749: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_STATE;
750: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = NULL;
751: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = 0;
752: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
753: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
754: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = 0;
755: 
756: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
757: 
758: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
759: 
760: 	return ret_val;
761: }

763: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_state_trigger(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
764: {
765: 	u32 flag = mb_uart_enter_critical();
766: 
767: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_in_process != 0)
768: 	{
769: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
770: 		mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
771: 		return BK_OK;
772: 	}
773: 
774: 	chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 1;
775: 
776: 	mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
777: 
778: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
779: 
780: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
781: 
782: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
783: 	{
784: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
785: 	}
786: 
787: 	return ret_val;

790: static u16 mb_uart_write_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 data_len)
791: {
792: 	u16    rem_len, wr_len;
793: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
794: 
795: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
796: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
797: 
798: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
799: 	{
800: 		rem_len = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
801: 	}
802: 	else
803: 	{
804: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
805: 	}
806: 
807: 	wr_len = data_len;
808: 	if(wr_len > rem_len)
809: 		wr_len = rem_len;
810: 
811: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
812: 	{
813: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
814: 	}
815: 	else
816: 	{
817: 		if(rd_idx != 0)
818: 			rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - wr_idx;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
819: 
820: 		if(rem_len >= wr_len)
821: 		{
822: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
823: 		}
824: 		else
825: 		{
826: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, rem_len);
827: 
828: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf, data_buf + rem_len, wr_len - rem_len);
829: 		}
830: 	}
831: 
832: 	chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx = (wr_idx + wr_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
833: 
834: 	/* trigger send! */
835: 	mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
836: 
837: 	return wr_len;
838: }

840: static u16 mb_uart_read_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 buf_len)
841: {
842: 	u16    rem_len, rd_len;
843: 
844: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
845: 		return 0;
846: 
847: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, data_cnt;
848: 
849: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
850: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
851: 
852: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
853: 	{
854: 		data_cnt = wr_idx - rd_idx;
855: 	}
856: 	else
857: 	{
858: 		data_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
859: 	}
860: 
861: 	rd_len = data_cnt;
862: 	if(rd_len > buf_len)
863: 		rd_len = buf_len;
864: 
865: 	if(rd_len == 0)
866: 	{
867: 		return 0;
868: 	}
869: 
870: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
871: 	{
872: 		memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
873: 		chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
874: 	}
875: 	else
876: 	{
877: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - rd_idx;
878: 
879: 		if(rem_len > rd_len)
880: 		{
881: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
882: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
883: 		}
884: 		else
885: 		{
886: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
887: 			if(rem_len < rd_len)
888: 			{
889: 				memcpy(data_buf + rem_len, chnl_cb->rx_buf, rd_len - rem_len);
890: 			}
891: 
892: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx = rd_len - rem_len;
893: 		}
894: 	}
895: 
896: 	data_cnt -= rd_len;
897: 
898: 	/* rts assert...... */
899: 	if(data_cnt < ((sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - 1 - MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN) * 8 / 10))
900: 	{
901: 		if( chnl_cb->ctrl_rts != 0)
902: 		{
903: 			chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 0;
904: 			mb_uart_send_state_trigger(chnl_cb);
905: 		}
906: 	}
907: 
908: 	return rd_len;
909: 
910: }

994: void bk_mb_uart_poll(u8 id)
995: {
996: 	if (id >= MB_UART_MAX || !mb_uart_cb[id].chnl_inited)
997: 		return;
998: 
999: 	mb_chnl_poll();
1000: 	if (mb_uart_cb[id].link_state == MB_UART_LINK_DOWN &&
1001: 		!mb_uart_cb[id].tx_in_process &&
1002: 		(int32_t)(rtos_get_time() - mb_uart_cb[id].probe_due_ms) >= 0)
1003: 	{
1004: 		mb_uart_cb[id].probe_count = 0;

114: static int ipc_heartbeat_timeout(void)
115: {
116: 	u32   cur_time;
117: 
118: 	cur_time = (u32)rtos_get_time();
119: 
120: 	if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
121: 	{
122: 		return 0;
123: 	}
124: 	if((cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING) || (cpu_x_dump != 0))
125: 	{
126: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = cur_time;
127: 		return 0;
128: 	}
129: 
130: 	if(cur_time >= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)
131: 	{
132: 		cur_time -= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp;
133: 	}
134: 	else
135: 	{
136: 		cur_time += (~(cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)) + 1;  // wrap around.
137: 	}
138: 
139: 	if(cur_time < HB_TIMEOUT_MS)
140: 	{
141: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
142: 		return 0;
143: 	}
144: 
145: 	if (bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_get(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT))
146: 	{
147: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
148: 		bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_clear(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT);
149: 		return 0;
150: 	}
151: 
152: 	if(s_mb_ipc_work_state == MB_IPC_EXIT_LV)
153: 	{
154: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
155: 		s_mb_ipc_work_state = MB_IPC_WORKING;
156: 		return 0;
157: 	}
158: 
159: 	return 1;

220: static void mb_ipc_task( void *para )
221: {
222: 	bk_err_t	ret_val;
223: 	u32    events;
224: 	u32    check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
225: 
226: 	mb_ipc_init_lv_callback();
227: 
228: 	ret_val = rtos_init_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event);
229: 
230: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
231: 	{
232: 		rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
233: 		return;
234: 	}
235: 
236: 	while(1)
237: 	{
238: 		events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_ALL_FLAGS, true, check_time);
239: 
240: 		if(events == 0)
241: 		{
242: 			// timeout, so check heartbeat.
243: 			events = MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG;
244: 		}
245: 
246: 		if(events & MB_IPC_STOP_CORE_FLAG)  // process this event at first!!!!
247: 		{
248: 			if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
249: 			{
250: 				events = 0;  // clear all events.
251: 			}
252: 		}
253: 
254: 		if(events & MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG)
255: 		{
256: 			u8   retry_cnt = 0;
257: 
258: 			while(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
259: 			{
260: 				ipc_heartbeat_timeout();
261: 
262: 				if(events & MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG)
263: 				{
264: 					if(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
265: 					{
266: 						cpu_x_state = CORE_POWER_ON;
267: 						break;  // cpu1 power on.
268: 					}
269: 				}
270: 				else
271: 				{
272: 					if( retry_cnt > 3)
273: 					{
274: 						BK_DUMP_OUT("IPC retry to start core%d, retry_cnt:%d\r\n", cpu_x_id, retry_cnt);
275: 						bk_pm_openvela_mailbox_diag_dump();
276: 						// restart_cpu_x();
277: 						break;
278: 					}
279: 					else
280: 					{
281: 						events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG, true, 2000);//2s
282: 					}
283: 				}
284: 
285: 				retry_cnt++;
286: 			}
287: 
288: 			// discard this event when not in CORE_STARTING state.
289: 		}
290: 
291: 		if(events & MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG)
292: 		{
293: 			if(ipc_heartbeat_timeout())
294: 			{
295: 				BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC[%d]heartbeat timeout %d,%d\r\n",cpu_x_id,cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp,(u32)rtos_get_time());
296: 				/*when cpu1 heartbeat timeout, then system reboot*/
297: 				cpu_x_heartbeat_timeout = 1;
298: 				ap_console_bridge_link_down();
299: 				BK_ASSERT(false);
300: 			}
301: 		}
302: 
303: 		if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
304: 		{
305: 			check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
306: 		}
307: 		else
308: 		{
309: 			check_time = HB_TIMEOUT_MS;
310: 		}
311: 	}
312: }

195:         }
196: 	}

432: static bk_err_t pm_openvela_clock_validate(void)
433: {
434: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
435: 	uint32_t clk = sys_drv_all_modules_clk_div_get(CLK_DIV_REG0);
436: 	uint32_t required = bk_pm_vdddig_required_get(PM_CPU_FRQ_480M);
437: 
438: 	if (bk_pm_module_current_cpu_freq_get(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1) != PM_CPU_FRQ_480M ||
439: 		bk_pm_current_max_cpu_freq_get() != PM_CPU_FRQ_480M ||
440: 		((clk >> 4) & 0x3) != 0x3 || ((clk >> 0) & 0xf) != 0x0 ||
441: 		((clk >> 6) & 0x1) != 0x1 ||
442: 		sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(0) != 0 ||
443: 		sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(1) != 1 ||
444: 		sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(2) != 1 ||
445: 		sys_hal_vdddig_h_vol_get() < required)
446: 	{
447: 		LOGE("OpenVela clock invalid slot/max=%d/%d clk=0x%x "
448: 			"speed=%d/%d/%d vdddig=0x%x need=0x%x\r\n",
449: 			bk_pm_module_current_cpu_freq_get(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1),
450: 			bk_pm_current_max_cpu_freq_get(), clk,
451: 			sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(0), sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(1),
452: 			sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(2), sys_hal_vdddig_h_vol_get(), required);
453: 		return BK_FAIL;
454: 	}
455: #if CONFIG_RX_OPTIMIZE
456: 	if (sys_hal_vddd_h_vol_get() < 0x7)
457: 	{
458: 		LOGE("OpenVela VDDD invalid: 0x%x\r\n",
459: 			sys_hal_vddd_h_vol_get());
460: 		return BK_FAIL;
461: 	}
462: #endif
463: #endif
464: 	return BK_OK;
465: }

467: static void pm_openvela_boot_rollback(void)
468: {
469: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
470: 	bk_err_t first = BK_OK;
471: 	bk_err_t ret;
472: 
473: 	ap_console_bridge_link_down();
474: #if CONFIG_MAILBOX
475: 	mb_ipc_reset_notify(1, 0);
476: #endif
477: 	ret = bk_cpu2_hold_reset();
478: 	pm_record_first_error(&first, ret);
479: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
480: 		LOGE("rollback: CPU2 reset hold failed: %d\r\n", ret);
481: 	ret = bk_cpu1_hold_reset();
482: 	pm_record_first_error(&first, ret);
483: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
484: 		LOGE("rollback: CPU1 reset hold failed: %d\r\n", ret);
485: 	ret = bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_OPENVELA,
486: 		PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
487: 	pm_record_first_error(&first, ret);
488: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
489: 		LOGE("rollback: OpenVela PSRAM release failed: %d\r\n", ret);
490: 	ret = bk_pm_openvela_cpu2_power_hold(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
491: 	pm_record_first_error(&first, ret);
492: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
493: 		LOGE("rollback: CPU2 power release failed: %d\r\n", ret);
494: 	ret = bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1,
495: 		PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
496: 	pm_record_first_error(&first, ret);
497: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
498: 		LOGE("rollback: CPU1 power release failed: %d\r\n", ret);
499: 	if (s_pm_openvela_freq_held)
500: 	{
501: 		ret = bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1, PM_CPU_FRQ_DEFAULT);
502: 		pm_record_first_error(&first, ret);
503: 		if (ret == BK_OK)
504: 			s_pm_openvela_freq_held = false;
505: 		else
506: 			LOGE("rollback: frequency release failed: %d\r\n", ret);
507: 	}
508: 	if (s_pm_openvela_cpu1_sleep_held)
509: 	{
510: 		ret = bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 1, 0);
511: 		pm_record_first_error(&first, ret);
512: 		if (ret == BK_OK)
513: 			s_pm_openvela_cpu1_sleep_held = false;
514: 		else
515: 			LOGE("rollback: CPU1 sleep vote restore failed: %d\r\n", ret);
516: 	}
517: 	s_pm_cp1_boot_ready = PM_MAILBOX_COMMUNICATION_INIT;
518: 	s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 0;
519: 	s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state = 0;
520: 	s_pm_cp1_closing = 0;
521: 	s_pm_cp1_closing_module = PM_BOOT_CP1_MODULE_NAME_MAX;
522: 	if (first != BK_OK)
523: 		LOGE("OpenVela rollback completed with error: %d\r\n", first);
524: #else
525: 	ap_console_bridge_link_down();
526: #if CONFIG_MAILBOX
527: 	mb_ipc_reset_notify(1, 0);
528: #endif
529: 	(void)bk_cpu1_hold_reset();
530: 	(void)bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1,
531: 		PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
532: #if CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV
533: 	(void)bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 1, 0);
534: #endif
535: #endif
536: }

538: bk_err_t bk_pm_openvela_ready_handle(uint32_t ready, int32_t error)
539: {
540: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
541: 	bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
542: 	uint32_t owner = 0x1U << PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_OPENVELA;
543: 
544: 	if (ready == 0)
545: 	{
546: 		if (error >= 0)
547: 			LOGE("OpenVela abort missing negative errno: %d\r\n", error);
548: 		else
549: 			LOGE("OpenVela boot aborted by AP: %d\r\n", error);
550: 		s_pm_openvela_boot_error = error < 0 ? error : BK_FAIL;
551: 		pm_openvela_boot_rollback();
552: 		return error < 0 ? error : BK_FAIL;
553: 	}
554: 	if (ready != 1)
555: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
556: 	if (s_pm_openvela_boot_stage != 5 ||
557: 		sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1) !=
558: 			PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON ||
559: 		sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2) !=
560: 			PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON ||
561: 		!s_pm_openvela_cpu2_held || !(s_pm_psram_ctrl_state & owner))
562: 	{
563: 		LOGE("OpenVela commit state invalid stage=%d cpu=%d/%d hold=%d psram=0x%x\r\n",
564: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage,
565: 			sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1),
566: 			sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2),
567: 			s_pm_openvela_cpu2_held, s_pm_psram_ctrl_state);
568: 		ret = BK_ERR_STATE;
569: 	}
570: 	if (ret == BK_OK)
571: 		ret = pm_openvela_clock_validate();
572: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
573: 	{
574: 		s_pm_openvela_boot_error = ret;
575: 		return ret;
576: 	}
577: 	s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 6;
578: 	ap_console_bridge_ready_update(AP_BRIDGE_READY_PWC, true);
579: 	(void)bk_pm_openvela_diag_dump();
580: 	return BK_OK;
581: #else
582: 	(void)ready;
583: 	(void)error;
584: 	return BK_ERR_NOT_SUPPORT;
585: #endif
586: }

588: static bk_err_t pm_module_bootup_cpu1(pm_power_module_name_e module)
589: {
590: 	uint64_t previous_tick = 0;
591: 	uint64_t current_tick   = 0;
592: 	bk_err_t ret;
593: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
594: 	if (module == PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1 &&
595: 		PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF != sys_drv_module_power_state_get(module))
596: 	{
597: 		LOGE("CPU1 powered before OpenVela lifecycle transaction\r\n");
598: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
599: 	}
600: #endif
601: 	if(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF == sys_drv_module_power_state_get(module))
602: 	{
603: 		if(module == PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1)
604: 		{
605: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
606: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_error = BK_OK;
607: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1, PM_CPU_FRQ_480M);
608: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
609: 				return ret;
610: 			s_pm_openvela_freq_held = true;
611: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 1;
612: 			ret = pm_openvela_clock_validate();
613: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
614: 				goto rollback;
615: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0);
616: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
617: 				goto rollback;
618: 			s_pm_openvela_cpu1_sleep_held = true;
619: 			if (!bk_cpu2_reset_is_held())
620: 			{
621: 				LOGE("CPU2 is not reset-held ctrl=0x%x run=0x%x\r\n",
622: 					bk_cpu2_ctrl_get(), bk_cpu_run_status_get());
623: 				ret = BK_ERR_STATE;
624: 				goto rollback;
625: 			}
626: 			ret = bk_pm_openvela_cpu2_power_hold(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
627: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
628: 				goto rollback;
629: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 2;
630: #else
631: #if CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV
632: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0);
633: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
634: 				return ret;
635: #endif
636: #endif
637: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1,
638: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
639: 			if (ret != BK_OK ||
640: 				sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1) !=
641: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)
642: 			{
643: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
644: 				if (sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1) ==
645: 					PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)
646: 					s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 3;
647: #endif
648: 				ret = ret == BK_OK ? BK_FAIL : ret;
649: 				goto rollback;
650: 			}
651: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
652: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 3;
653: #endif
654: 
655: 			#if defined(RECV_LOG_FROM_MBOX)
656: 			void reset_forward_log_status(void);
657: 			// reset cpu1's log transfer status on cpu0.
658: 			reset_forward_log_status();
659: 			#endif
660: 
661: 			#if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
662: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 4;
663: 			#endif
664: 			mb_chnl_quiesce(MAILBOX_CPU1);
665: 			ret = bk_cpu1_start_partition();
666: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
667: 				goto rollback;
668: 			mb_ipc_reset_notify(1, 1);
669: 
670: 			previous_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
671: 			current_tick = previous_tick;
672: 			while((current_tick - previous_tick) < (PM_BOOT_CP1_WAITING_TIEM*AON_RTC_MS_TICK_CNT))
673: 			{
674: 				if (bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get()
675: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
676: 					|| s_pm_openvela_boot_error != BK_OK
677: #endif
678: 				)
679: 				{
680: 					break;
681: 				}
682: 				/* Drain AP mailbox descriptors directly during the CPU1 boot
683: 				 * transaction.  The normal ap_console task may not be scheduled
684: 				 * while this high-priority wait is active.
685: 				 */
686: 				mb_chnl_poll();
687: 				current_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
688: 				/* The AP mailbox upper layer is drained by ap_console.  Yield
689: 				 * while waiting for CPU1 so that STATE/ACK traffic is dispatched.
690: 				 */
691: 				rtos_delay_milliseconds(1);
692: 			}
693: 			#if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
694: 			if (s_pm_openvela_boot_error != BK_OK)
695: 				return s_pm_openvela_boot_error;
696: 			#endif
697: 
698: 			if(!bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get())
699: 			{
700: 				volatile uint32_t *trace = (volatile uint32_t *)0x2800ffe0;
701: 
702: 				LOGE("CPU1 boot timeout stage=%d\r\n",
703: 					s_pm_openvela_boot_stage);
704: 				#if CONFIG_MAILBOX
705: 				pm_dump_ap_mailbox_diag();
706: 				#endif
707: 				LOGE("AP trace=%08x primary=%u secondary=%u detail=%08x/%08x/%08x/%08x/%08x\r\n",
708: 					trace[0], trace[1], trace[2], trace[3], trace[4],
709: 					trace[5], trace[6], trace[7]);
710: 				ret = BK_ERR_TIMEOUT;
711: 				goto rollback;
712: 			}
713: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
714: 			if (s_pm_openvela_boot_stage == 4)
715: 				s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 5;
716: 			(void)bk_pm_openvela_diag_dump();
717: #endif
718: 		}
719: 	}
720: 	return BK_OK;
721: 
722: rollback:
723: 	pm_openvela_boot_rollback();
724: 	(void)bk_pm_openvela_diag_dump();
725: 	return ret;
726: }

810: bk_err_t bk_pm_module_vote_boot_cp1_ctrl(pm_boot_cp1_module_name_e module,pm_power_module_state_e power_state)
811: {
812: 	bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
813: 	GLOBAL_INT_DECLARATION();
814: 
815: 	BK_LOGD(NULL,"boot_cp1 %d %d 0x%x [%d][0x%x]E_1\r\n",module, power_state,s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state,s_pm_cp1_closing,&s_sync_cp1_open_sema);
816: 	if (NULL == s_sync_cp1_open_sema)
817: 	{
818: 		rtos_init_semaphore(&s_sync_cp1_open_sema, 1);
819: 	}
820: 	if(s_pm_cp1_closing)
821: 	{
822: 		GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
823: 		s_pm_cp1_sema_count++;
824: 		GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
825: 		BK_LOGD(NULL,"boot_cp1 get sema[%d][0x%x]\r\n",s_pm_cp1_sema_count,&s_sync_cp1_open_sema);
826: 
827: 		/*add protect:init again when the s_sync_cp1_open_sema free*/
828: 		if (NULL == s_sync_cp1_open_sema)
829: 		{
830: 			rtos_init_semaphore(&s_sync_cp1_open_sema, 1);
831: 		}
832: 		ret = rtos_get_semaphore(&s_sync_cp1_open_sema, PM_OPEN_CP1_TIMEOUT);
833: 
834: 		GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
835: 		s_pm_cp1_sema_count--;
836: 		GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
837: 		if(ret == kTimeoutErr)
838: 		{
839: 			BK_LOGD(NULL,"boot_cp1[%d]0x%llx %d %d %d\r\n",ret,s_pm_cp1_module_recovery_state,bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get(),bk_pm_cp1_recovery_all_state_get(),s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state);
840: 			if (s_pm_cp1_closing)
841: 				pm_cp1_close_cancel();
842: 			return ret;
843: 		}
844: 	}
845: 	BK_LOGD(NULL,"boot_cp1 %d %d 0x%x [%d]E_2\r\n",module, power_state,s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state,ret);
846:     if(power_state == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)//power on
847:     {
848: 		GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
849: 		s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state |= 0x1 << (module);
850: 		GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
851: 		ret = pm_module_bootup_cpu1(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1);
852: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
853: 		{
854: 			GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
855: 			s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state &= ~(0x1 << module);
856: 			GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
857: 			return ret;
858: 		}
859:     }
860:     else //power down
861:     {
862: 		if(s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state&(0x1 << (module)))
863: 		{
864: 			GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
865: 			s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state &= ~(0x1 << (module));
866: 			GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
867: 			if(0x0 == s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state)
868: 			{
